title: Bosonic Diffusive Channel: Quantum Metrology via Finite Non-Gaussian Resource
summary: We investigate the estimation of dephasing-induced decoherence in continuous-variable quantum systems using non-Gaussian probe states. By purifying the open system, we identify optimal probes, specifically squeezed cat and symmetric squeezed compass states, via quantum Fisher information. These results are in agreement with numerical simulation.
